name: nook-code-arena
description: Code Arena, the first-game implementation baseline for Nook's ft_transcendence project.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace arena-model && npm run build --workspace arena-game-engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:example
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace arena-game && npm run build --workspace arena-judge-worker && npm run build --workspace arena-frontend
scripts.lint:boundaries: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages services frontend scripts user-service auth-profile-web
scripts.check: npm run check:repository && npm run lint:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:example
scripts.typecheck:example: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext packages/example/src/index.ts packages/example/test/example.test.ts
